admission.justification: Naming without source/card/record text requires this explicit boundary or locator contract; otherwise callers can use removed carrier arguments, attach a governing statement to the wrong card section, or treat an unresolved record location as verified.

applicability: The mounted knowledge_read supported named-row projections on the selected converted knowledge epoch.
conditions: Canonical configured or per-call admitted reader roots and the selected immutable source/memory epoch remain authoritative.
exclusions: Source inspection and producer fixture evidence do not establish fresh runtime execution, current CODE acceptance, metadata-only acceptance, or a semantic verdict.
Private/dashboard/CLI full-result composition is not replaced by mounted naming.
statement: Answer rows carry ID, kind, computed state and location with no record text: member rows name the member record with the family beside it, declarations win over mentions, header references name families, and failed walks fall back to unverifiable.
